purpose: A message bar for app-wide notices, subscription warnings, announcements and global errors: a full-width banner by the header (horizontal) or a boxed message in content (vertical). It stays until it is closed or resolved.

notFor.case: Feedback after an action that should dismiss itself.

Default.visual: By Appearance: outline on Surface/layer-1 with the severity border (Border/accent for default, Border/default for secondary, e.g. Status/critical/border) and the severity icon ink, text Content/primary; solid on the severity solid fill (Action/primary/default, Action/secondary/default or e.g. Status/critical/surface-solid) with its on-solid ink; soft on the severity surface (Surface/accent, Surface/layer-2 or e.g. Status/critical/surface); inverse on Surface/inverse with Content/inverse.

Closed.meaning: The person pressed the close and the app handled onClose.

a11y.keyboard: No keys of its own; Tab reaches its action and close buttons.
notes: Convey severity with the icon and the text as well as colour.
Give the close button an accessible name (closeLabel).

openQuestions: role="alert" interrupts the screen reader at once. Should non-urgent variants (default, secondary, info) use role="status" instead?
The default icon is the Sparkle for every severity (alert-contract.md). Should each severity get its own glyph, as Toast does?
